Production state reference Use existing identity and costume sheets No new body dimensions
Final Tech Mech One machine and the same loaded knee throughout
P18 First hop and hard landing
Thruster draw dims lattice
P19 Second hop and forced angle
Armor holds; knee conduit ruptures
P20 Drops to damaged knee
Torn off cannon stays off
P20 Warehouse impact opens armor
Same ruptured conduit exposed
P20 Injection behind lattice
Single onboard crystal overloads
P21 and P22 Opened cockpit
Pilot revealed; wreck stays wrecked
Knee side remains unassigned until an approved view fixes it. Never mirror or repair it between shots.
Midori Protection changes but grief and physical wear persist
P35 Uniform cut by near misses; no shield screen on flanks or back.
P36 to P39 Carry the same cuts and dirt through the continuous battle and mourning.
P37 onward Layered formation protection; later solo flight uses a close wind shield.
P40 time cut Do not assume a repair. If a repaired version is approved, record its first use.
P41 onward Marta's notebook inside uniform; same pocket touched on P44.
P50 to P52 Red hand lines and fatigue do not vanish before the scripted discharge sequence.
Marta Adnil and Buren Objects do not reset between shots
Adnil Staff dropped before impact; recovered staff lies beside her covered body.
Marta Charm active then dark then broken; notebook retrieved from the support column.
Marta Wound location follows first approved depiction; no healing interval or last speech.
Buren Helmet removed on P22; any later equipment reset must be deliberate after a cut.
Chapter scripted mana colors Local source sequence only
P16 Blue to green and yellow, briefly orange; fatigue carries into the duel.
P43 Blue to green to yellow in the later absorption beat.
P50 Green to yellow to orange to deep crimson; ground discharge barely helps.
P51 and P52 Crimson persists, then final surge brings orange, yellow and green.
Older fixed eye color reference conflicts with the locked chapter. No global canon amendment made here.
No tear positions, wound side, repairs, ranks, ages or physical dimensions are invented by this sheet.
All wording is production guidance only and must never appear as manga page lettering
